mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 67 degrees out by the Military Ridge State Trail, and the moon is in its first quarter. Tonight, the space station will be visible for two minutes starting at 11:10 PM, moving from over Cross Plains toward Oregon and reaching halfway up the sky. The temperature will dip to an overnight low of 53 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona reminds residents that the VHAT cable channel is your go-to source for local government meetings and information. Additionally, the city offers guidance on residential parking regulations for your vehicles and trailers, as well as resources for managing organic waste through home composting and the free Food Scrap Stop program located at Badger Prairie County Park.

There is plenty to do in town. We have trivia happening today at both Hop Haus Brewing Company and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, yoga at Insight Wellness, and even more trivia options at Paddy Mac's and The Bogey Factory.
In a look back at the weekly police report, on July 13, an officer assisted at a scene where a vehicle was stuck on a rock, which resulted in the driver being arrested for an O-W-I.
You are in for a treat with today's flavor, Chocolate Caramel Twist. Please note the restaurant is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10:00 AM tomorrow.
